items.title: Implement M2 reserved proof-key metadata contract
items.context: Define reserved proof-key registry, classify caller/server/proof/diagnostic metadata, strip or reject reserved proof keys from caller-writable metadata while preserving ordinary metadata, and add B-e9cb/B-bfa9-style regression coverage.
items.userSees: Reserved proof-looking metadata keys are stripped or rejected from caller-writable metadata while ordinary metadata survives, verified by proof-admissibility-hardening smoke output.

happy.desc: Ordinary caller metadata survives sanitization unchanged.

edge.desc: Known reserved proof keys are stripped or rejected at caller-writable boundaries.

adversarial.desc: Nested or linked metadata cannot preseed hostDeclarationDigest/providerAuthorization/receiptVerified/productionDone proof-looking fields accepted as proof.

verificationEvidence.note: Hardening smoke covers reserved proof-key stripping/rejection, nested linked spoof keys, delegated metadata spoofing, and ordinary metadata preservation.
TypeScript build passes with metadata sanitizers wired into runner registration, job spec, and provider event parsing.

items.title: Implement M3 semantic binding and versioned verification
items.context: Define canonical signed/digested payload helpers, require schema/verifier/contract version checks where proof is consumed, reject null/extra/missing semantic fields, and add tamper tests for reason/verdict/story/head/material/signature fields.
items.userSees: Semantic proof tamper cases reject edits to reason, verdict, schema, null, extra keys, story/head/material binding, and digest/signature subjects.

happy.desc: Canonical payload helper produces stable digest for valid proof payloads with supported schema/verifier/contract versions.

edge.desc: Null, missing, and extra proof fields fail strict shape before trust.

adversarial.desc: Changing reason, verdict, story id, head hash, material hash, or semantic fields changes digest or fails verification.

verificationEvidence.note: Hardening smoke covers versioned canonical binding plus reason/verdict/story/head/material/signature-like tamper and null/extra/missing field rejection.
Existing proof admissibility smoke still passes after strict Authority proof schema and binding helper additions.

items.title: Implement M4 gate warn-mode integration
items.context: Route REVIEW/TEST/DONE/DONE_REQUIRED/Authority/handoff/local-quorum consumer paths through the shared proof admissibility evaluator in warning/diagnostic mode first, with stable reason codes and remediation hints; update process fact registry if a new gate fact is consumed.
items.userSees: Gate diagnostics show each consumed proof-looking artifact scope, claim, consumer, reason code, and remediation hint in warn mode without breaking legacy local flows.

happy.desc: Strong local DONE-required evidence emits local-gate-evidence diagnostics, not productionDone.

edge.desc: Legacy/local/diagnostic gate inputs emit warnings with stable reason codes and remediation hints.

adversarial.desc: A proof-looking artifact routed to the wrong consumer/claim is diagnosed as consumer or claim mismatch and cannot silently satisfy production completion.

verificationEvidence.note: Hardening smoke covers warn-mode diagnostic output with scope, reason code, and remediation for inadmissible gate-facing evidence.
Process fact registry includes runtime:proof_admissibility_gate_diagnostic and contract verification passes.

items.title: Implement M5 legacy scope and migration diagnostics
items.context: Classify old evidence lacking new fields as legacy-observed/local-only/unknown-producer, keep it audit-readable, prevent it from satisfying strong proof claims, and provide dry-run repair/migration diagnostics where mechanical upgrade is possible.
items.userSees: Legacy evidence is reported as legacy-observed, legacy-local-only, or legacy-unknown-producer and remains audit-readable while failing strong production proof claims.

happy.desc: Legacy artifacts without current contract fields remain readable and return legacy scope classification.

edge.desc: Mechanically upgradable legacy artifacts produce dry-run repair diagnostics without mutating evidence by default.

adversarial.desc: Legacy evidence cannot satisfy production-completion or Authority receipt claims even if prose says verified.

verificationEvidence.note: Hardening smoke covers legacy-observed, legacy-local-only, and legacy-unknown-producer classification as readable but non-strong proof.

items.title: Implement M6 host handoff and multi-host boundary
items.context: Split handoff artifacts into context/evidenceCandidate/diagnosticReceipt/admissibleProofRef, preserve productionDone=false unless a matching gate consumes a verified receipt, add host identity fields for local quorum without Authority overclaim, and surface admissibility summaries for Codex/Claude/Antigravity entry paths.
items.userSees: Handoff and host entry summaries separate context, evidenceCandidate, diagnosticReceipt, and admissibleProofRef while keeping productionDone false unless a matching gate consumes verified proof.

happy.desc: Handoff summary renders the four artifact classes with scope and remediation hints.

edge.desc: Local quorum host identity fields are present but remain local-review-quorum, not Authority completion.

adversarial.desc: Diagnostic handoff receipts and host-local outputs cannot set receiptVerified, authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, or productionDone.

verificationEvidence.note: Hardening smoke covers handoff context/evidenceCandidate/diagnosticReceipt/admissibleProofRef split and no receiptVerified/authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone overclaim.
TypeScript build passes with handoff admissibility summary threaded through pack, inspect, accept, resume, receipt-submit, and dispatch projections.

items.title: Implement M7 enforce rollout and adversarial regression suite
items.context: Add proofAdmissibility.mode warn|enforce policy, enforce high-risk proof consumption paths, add adversarial regression cases from the plan, and finish with 3 rounds x 2 host review evidence over final material.
items.userSees: proofAdmissibility.mode supports warn and enforce; high-risk proof consumers reject inadmissible artifacts in enforce mode; adversarial suite passes; final DONE records 3 rounds x 2 host review assurance.

happy.desc: proofAdmissibility.mode=warn reports diagnostics while allowing local development flows; mode=enforce rejects high-risk inadmissible proof consumers.

edge.desc: Adversarial regression suite covers reserved-key injection, delegated metadata spoof, stale hash, wrong story, wrong target phase, wrong key, bad signature, null/extra/missing field, omitted semantic field, diagnostic handoff receipt, raw red probe, stale current green, command mismatch, candidate mutation, bootstrap noise, and matrix-gap policy exception.

adversarial.desc: Final material has 3 rounds x 2 host review assurance and no inadmissible proof-looking artifact can satisfy a strong gate in enforce mode.

verificationEvidence.note: Hardening smoke covers proofAdmissibility warn/enforce behavior and enforce-mode blocking for high-risk inadmissible proof consumers.
Package script test:proof-admissibility-hardening compiles and runs from dist.
Deferred until after REVIEW because final 3 rounds x 2 host assurance can only be produced over final reviewed material; DONE gate will require real quorum evidence before completion.
